sum: CCH Holdings Ltd operates as a specialty hotpot restaurant chain in Malaysia. The company offers chicken hotpot and fish head hotpot. It also provides catering services under Chicken Claypot House and Zi Wei Yuan through company-owned restaurant outlets and franchised restaurant outlets. In addition, the company operates or licenses restaurant outlets under the 888 Family Food Court, Bibixian, Banbudian Bistro, and Chao Liu Xian Hotpot brands. Further, it sells food ingredients and condiments; and franchise licensing. CCH Holdings Ltd was founded in 2015 and is headquartered in Bukit Mertajam, Malaysia.
ceo: Mr. Kok E. Goh (Chairman, Co-CEO & COO)
